title: Kissed Light Dutch Rainbow Trout Tagine
description: A fresh and light Dutch dish featuring rainbow trout, cooked in a tagine pot with beurre-monte and satvik-friendly ingredients, perfect for a healthy and energizing meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the rainbow trout fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the tagine pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rainbow trout fillets to the tagine pot and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Add the beurre-monte, lemon juice, and chopped parsley to the tagine pot and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the trout for 8 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the tagine pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kissed light Dutch rainbow trout tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
